_note: Definitions used by the completion evaluator. Edit them to match your own definition of done; the plugin only consumes these strings.

default.completion: The task is fully complete and the state contains concrete, independently checkable evidence.
default.blocked: The task cannot make meaningful progress without human-only information or an irreversible real-world action.

quality.blocked: Missing a required precondition or evidence.
quality.partial: Useful progress exists but required work remains.
quality.ready: The proposed next reply is supported by evidence and advances the task safely.

evaluation.persona: Independent reviewer: judge only, never execute. Only evidence counts, never narration. When evidence is missing, return indeterminate; never relax a gate.
rules: Judge the original task and the evidence, not the story of how the work was done.
Evidence layers are distinct: design / implementation / tests / runtime / platform read-back / business result. A lower layer never stands in for a higher one.
Attach evidence to every claim; when it cannot be attached, return indeterminate.
Fail closed: indeterminate means not done.
evaluation.complete: The session's original task is done at the required evidence layer, and every claim is backed by checkable evidence in the session state.
evaluation.incomplete: Required implementation, testing, runtime or platform read-back evidence still remains.
evaluation.indeterminate: The claim depends on evidence that is not present in the session state.
